item.title: Joe DiGenova resigns from DOJ after overseeing "grand conspiracy" probe
item.description: Joe DiGenova, the prosecutor who was tapped by Attorney General Todd Blanche to supervise the "grand conspiracy" investigation targeting Obama- and Biden-era officials, told CBS News he has resigned.

item.title: Diesel prices are nearing $6 a gallon for the first time ever
item.description: The price of diesel has soared more than 60% over the last year, a surge energy experts said is likely to continue. Here's why.

item.title: Trump's $5,000 payments would reignite inflation, economists say
item.description: Mr. Trump's pledge to give $5,000 to Americans would stoke inflation and worsen the nation's fiscal outlook, according to economists.

item.title: Daughters of 9/11 victims on whether alleged mastermind will face justice: "System is failing"
item.description: Elizabeth Miller's father, Douglas, was a firefighter killed in the World Trade Center on 9/11. Jessica Trant's father, Daniel, was a Cantor Fitzgerald bond salesman who died on the 104th floor of the north tower. Miller and Trant are now confronting whether or not the alleged mastermind behind the attacks, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, will ever face justice. Their journey is chronicled in the new documentary "Daughters of 9/11", which premieres Friday. The two joined CBS News to discuss their story.

item.title: Iran strikes U.S. jets after Trump promises war to end after midterms
item.description: U.S. jets were hit by Iranian missiles while parked at a base in Jordan, sources tell CBS News, while Trump said the war will end "immediately" after midterms.

item.title: Why you shouldn't bank on Trump's $5,000 dividends happening
item.description: President Trump pledged $5,000 to all American adults if Republicans retain control of Congress. You may not be able to take that to the bank.

item.title: Anthropic says it blocked possible efforts to create biological weapons
item.description: One day after two researchers warned that artificial intelligence could kill all humans, Anthropic reports that it blocked possible efforts by scientists to create biological weapons. Andy Weber, senior fellow at the Council on Strategic Risks, joins CBS News to discuss.
